history.speaker: You
history.text: Hello! I'd like to discuss how we can split these items.

history.speaker: Them
history.text: Hi! I'm interested in the books and basketballs.

history.speaker: You
history.text: I also need some books. How about I take 2 books and you take 1 book?

history.speaker: Them
history.text: That could work. What about the hats?

history.speaker: You
history.text: You can have all the hats. I don't need them.

history.speaker: You
history.text: How about we split them? I'll take 1 basketball and you take 1.

history.speaker: Them
history.text: That sounds fair. So I get 1 book, 2 hats, and 1 basketball?

history.speaker: You
history.text: Yes, and I get 2 books and 1 basketball. Deal?
